posts.title: Saving Eurovision (if you want to)
posts.description: 1. Boot Morrocan Oil. Get their services out of backstage. 2. Boot Israel. They are cheats, not to mention, well, everything. 3. Give 1/3 of the finals vote to the stadium. No more countries outright buying the public vote. Martin Green, call me. Then fire yourself.
